_comment: Epic 1 (Measurement Validation Gate) — S2-group BASELINE app on Pixel 9 over WiFi-ADB. APK from https://github.com/S2-group/android-apps-benchmark APKs/Baseline/e.www.baseline.apk (cloned to _external/android-apps-benchmark/). The Baseline app's MainActivity is empty (just setContentView), so this measures the phone's baseline energy with a foreground Activity + screen on. Pairs with validation_s2_cpu_high_pixel9_wifi.json. No usb_handler block — hub adapter is dead, Pixel 9 is on WiFi-ADB only. Run command (from android-runner/ with venv active): python3 . examples/batterymanager/validation_s2_baseline_pixel9_wifi.json
